name: Directus
description: Directus is a self-hostable, open-source headless CMS and backend that connects to any SQL database and instantly generates REST and GraphQL APIs plus a no-code admin interface.
best_for: Development and content teams that want to turn an existing SQL database into a governed API and content backend without vendor lock-in.
features: Instant REST and GraphQL API generation from an existing database
No-code admin interface (Studio) for content management and data governance
Digital asset manager with CDN-ready file transformation
Real-time updates via WebSockets and subscriptions
Role-based access control for both human users and AI agents
Native MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor integrations
Self-hosted via npm on your own infrastructure or managed Directus Cloud

alternatives.name: Strapi
alternatives.description: An open-source, TypeScript-based headless CMS that lets developers build content APIs without vendor lock-in.
alternatives.best_for: Developers wanting full data ownership and a self-hostable headless CMS

alternatives.name: Sanity
alternatives.description: A headless CMS built around structured content and a real-time collaborative editing environment.
alternatives.best_for: Developer teams wanting real-time collaboration and customizable editing tools

alternatives.name: Contentful
alternatives.description: A headless CMS providing structured content management and delivery through APIs for web and mobile apps.
alternatives.best_for: Teams needing an enterprise-ready headless CMS with strong API tooling

pricing.starting_price: Core: $0; Team: $499/month with annual commitment ($599 month-to-month)

tiers.name: Core
tiers.notes: 3 seats, 25 collections, 5 flows; cloud hosting is an optional add-on.

tiers.name: Team
tiers.notes: $499/month with annual commitment; $599/month on rolling monthly billing; includes 10 SSO seats.

cons: Core has hard limits including 3 seats, 25 collections, and 5 flows; SSO is not available on Core.
Team is a large price step at $499/month with an annual commitment ($599 month-to-month), while Enterprise pricing is custom.
